speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, it's very simple. In our ragtag band of scientists with nothing to lose, I'm the smart one, Wallens is the funny one, and Kuthrapali is the lovable foreigner who struggles to understand our ways and fails. Well, that leaves you, by default, as the muscle.

speaker: Leonard
text: Why do I always have to carry the heavy stuff? One more floor and I'd be the pulled muscle. Uh, well, we didn't actually get Chinese food. Don't panic, this is better.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, it's about time. I'm starving. Why not? Oh, no. You didn't trade the food for magic beans, did you?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Of course not. And technically magic beans would be food. Although eating them would be quite a waste, since you could plant them, and overnight have a giant beanstalk, which would provide enough roughage for a small city.

speaker: Penny
text: Yeah, sometimes I don't listen, sometimes I just watch your jaw go up and down.

speaker: Leonard
text: We were on our way to the Chinese restaurant when we thought we saw Adam West, so we followed him.

text: Who's Adam West? What did the two of you talk about after the coitus? My guess is, hey, four minutes, new record!
